# Level Cleanup: lift faces kept

Written by ALTLevelCleanupList. The faces the lift crawl found behind a sealed lift's door that a sight line
still reaches, so the cleanup keeps them. Check them in play; any that should go can be named in
data/LevelCleanupExtra.json (by face number as the Face Index Display shows it with Level Cleanup off, or by
corners, which do not move) and the list made again.
